name: fiken-mcp
description: The agent-native Fiken CLI: full read coverage with offline search and a local SQLite mirror, plus the gated, audited, idempotent write and bank-reconciliation layer no other Fiken tool has.

fiken_api_token.title: FIKEN_API_TOKEN
fiken_api_token.description: Optional. Personal API token (Fiken -> Settings -> API -> Personlige API-nokler). Sent as a Bearer token; never expires; ToS-clean for your own companies. Set this OR run 'auth login' for OAuth2.

fiken_client_id.title: FIKEN_CLIENT_ID
fiken_client_id.description: Optional. OAuth2 client ID, used only by 'auth login' when acting on behalf of other companies. Not needed if you use a personal API token.

fiken_client_secret.title: FIKEN_CLIENT_SECRET
fiken_client_secret.description: Optional. OAuth2 client secret, used only by 'auth login'. Not needed if you use a personal API token.

fiken_no_lock.title: FIKEN_NO_LOCK
fiken_no_lock.description: Sets FIKEN_NO_LOCK for the Fiken MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
